manifest.research_question: Research verified literature where user next-item behavior, hyperbolic geometry and generative semantic IDs intersect.

sources.title: TIGER: Transformer Index for GEnerative Recommenders

overlap.user_next_item_behavior: FULL_TEXT — autoregressive recommendation predicts subsequent items from user interaction history.
overlap.hyperbolic_geometry: UNKNOWN — no evidence verified that hyperbolic geometry is part of the method.
overlap.generative_semantic_ids: FULL_TEXT — proposes semantic item identifiers and generative retrieval/recommendation by predicting identifier tokens.

sources.intersection_assessment: Strong evidence for sequential user behavior plus generative semantic IDs, but no established hyperbolic component; not evidence of the full three-way intersection.

sources.title: HME: A Hyperbolic Metric Embedding Approach for Next-POI Recommendation

overlap.user_next_item_behavior: ABSTRACT — next point-of-interest recommendation from user mobility/sequential behavior.
overlap.hyperbolic_geometry: ABSTRACT — explicitly proposes hyperbolic metric embedding.
overlap.generative_semantic_ids: UNKNOWN — no evidence verified of autoregressive generative semantic item IDs.

sources.intersection_assessment: Relevant hyperbolic sequential recommendation baseline, but not established as a generative semantic-ID method.

sources.title: Scalable hyperbolic recommender systems

overlap.user_next_item_behavior: UNKNOWN — recommender/user preference modeling is in scope, but next-item sequential prediction was not verified.

overlap.generative_semantic_ids: UNKNOWN — no verified generative semantic-ID mechanism.

sources.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations

overlap.user_next_item_behavior: FULL_TEXT — frames recommendation as sequential transduction over user actions and interaction histories.
overlap.hyperbolic_geometry: UNKNOWN — no verified hyperbolic geometry component.
overlap.generative_semantic_ids: UNKNOWN — generative recommendation is verified, but semantic IDs are not established from the inspected abstract/full-text metadata.

sources.intersection_assessment: Relevant for behavior-first generative recommendation framing, not proof of the three-way intersection.

behavior_problem_candidates.candidate: Model next-item choice as a conditional distribution over the user's recent interaction/action sequence, with the target item represented by a semantic identifier sequence.
behavior_problem_candidates.status: Supported as adjacent strands; no verified source combines this with hyperbolic geometry.

behavior_problem_candidates.candidate: Use hyperbolic structure to represent hierarchical or multiscale relations in user/item behavior, then test whether it improves next-item prediction when paired with generative semantic IDs.
behavior_problem_candidates.status: Research hypothesis/synthesis, not a claim already demonstrated by these sources.

limitations: No independently verified paper was found in this search that demonstrably combines all three elements: user next-item behavior, hyperbolic geometry, and generative semantic IDs.

FULL_TEXT is used only where an arXiv full-text/PDF is directly available and the relevant method can be checked; HME is labeled ABSTRACT because publisher DOI metadata/abstract are available but a full text was not verified here.
UNKNOWN means the stated feature was not established from the accessible evidence, not proof that the paper lacks it.
Search coverage was targeted rather than systematic; terms such as semantic item codes, tokenized item IDs, hyperbolic sequential recommendation, and next-POI may yield additional adjacent work.
The queried Crossref record independently confirms HME's title/DOI and cites Scalable hyperbolic recommender systems and HME; arXiv records independently identify the listed preprints.
